scientific_integrity: Analytic theorem with explicit signed-cut proof, sharp nine-vertex classification, and finite support checks; all proofs and executable checks included.
scientific_limitations: The result characterizes the diagonal signed-critical-point mechanism on unit-weight sinusoidal trees only. It neither classifies all heteroclinic intersections nor certifies historical priority; independent audit not performed.
title: Unequal-bipartition heteroclinic obstructions in discrete Huygens trees
